# OneTake

> Script product demo videos for web apps: a human-like cursor drives the real UI with trusted input, a smooth camera zooms on what matters, hand-drawn highlights and captions guide the viewer, and a frame-by-frame recorder renders a 60 fps MP4 (window frame, intro/outro cards, sound, subtitles, chapters, thumbnail, GIF/WebM, vertical crops). One tour script spans page loads; every take is identical.

## For AI agents

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the workflow for making a demo video of a project (pick a scenario from its browser tests, sign in with a saved session, map the DOM, write the tour, `onetake check`, `onetake record`, look at frames), API and recorder cheat sheets, gotchas.
- [skills/onetake-demo-video/SKILL.md](skills/onetake-demo-video/SKILL.md): the same workflow as a Claude skill.
- [templates/demo-kit/](templates/demo-kit/): starter kit to copy next to a project (onetake.config.js, tour.js, steps.js, record.sh).
- [docs/ai-agents.md](docs/ai-agents.md): how people ask an agent for a video.
- [docs/mcp.md](docs/mcp.md): `onetake mcp`, an MCP server with open_page, inspect_page (targets for every control), test_target, run_steps, screenshot, check_tour, record_video, get_docs.

## Docs

Online: https://tharinduwijayarathna.github.io/onetake/ (llms-full.txt there has every page in one file).


- [docs/getting-started.md](docs/getting-started.md): install, first video.
- [docs/writing-tours.md](docs/writing-tours.md): how tours run, multi-page tours, storytelling, reusable steps (OneTake.define, includes).
- [docs/targets.md](docs/targets.md): text=, text*=, label=, role=, CSS, `>>` chaining, nth=, shadow DOM, iframes, strict matching.
- [docs/waiting-and-assertions.md](docs/waiting-and-assertions.md): actionability, settling, expect(), expectUrl(), scrollUntil().
- [docs/api.md](docs/api.md): every step and option.
- [docs/camera-and-highlights.md](docs/camera-and-highlights.md): zoom, autoZoom, highlight shapes, captions, cursor.
- [docs/recording.md](docs/recording.md): the onetake CLI (init, check, record, login, --watch), onetake.config.js, all flags, frame-by-frame vs realtime, logins.
- [docs/output.md](docs/output.md): frame and backgrounds, intro/outro, sound and music, subtitles, chapters, thumbnails, formats, --aspect.
- [docs/recipes.md](docs/recipes.md): custom dropdowns, comboboxes, date pickers, modals, uploads, drag and drop, tables, rich text, shortcuts, demo data, --now, languages, CI.
- [docs/troubleshooting.md](docs/troubleshooting.md): every error message and fix.
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md), [docs/contributing.md](docs/contributing.md).

## Code

- [dist/onetake.js](dist/onetake.js): the bundled library (UMD, no dependencies). [types/onetake.d.ts](types/onetake.d.ts): TypeScript types.
- [bin/onetake.js](bin/onetake.js): the `onetake` command. [src/recorder/](src/recorder/): cli, config, session (multi-page, trusted input), frames, realtime, clock, render, audio, login. [src/library/](src/library/): library modules bundled into dist/.
